text:
Ellen Park: quick follow-up to the precision profiles thread - proposal for per-layer "safety thresholds" that gate head-level int4 patches. want a concrete contract so runtime + QA can automate rollbacks.
Victor Zhou: sounds useful. what would the contract look like?
Ellen Park: minimal: profile.policies.safety = { "max_divergence": 0.06, "golden_sample_size": 80, "head_coverage": "auto|explicit" } - runtime runs golden probes during canary and computes divergence. if > max_divergence -> throttle patch.
Liam O.: +1. add an override for "cost_sensitivity" so we can allow slightly higher divergence for very high-cost endpoints.
Ellen Park: good call. example: cost_sensitivity: low|medium|high. low => strict thresholds.
Victor Zhou: implementation detail: we must be careful with per-layer patches that only touch a few heads. need head-annotated golden prompts and a fallback rule: if coverage < 60% of affected heads (can't trigger probes for all), block automatic promotion.
qa-bot: suggestion: add metric quant.patch.head_coverage and quant.patch.divergence. create alert when divergence > threshold AND head_coverage > 0.6.
Liam O.: runtime should emit resolved_key + list of applied_patch_ids in traces. cache-key stays sha256(base_id + sorted(patch_ids) + fingerprint) as usual.
Ellen Park: rollout plan: 1) add schema for safety policy and cost_sensitivity; 2) require golden_sample_size > 0 for any patch that changes head dtypes; 3) implement canary probe harness that picks head-specific prompts; 4) block auto-promote if head_coverage < 0.6 or divergence > threshold.
Victor Zhou: QA: will build head-annotated prompt sets and a small fuzz runner to surface edge cases. will also add negative test that forces divergence to ensure rollbacks happen.
Liam O.: infra: add a lint rule to reject patches without safety policy. also add a migration step that annotates existing patches with conservative safety defaults.
Ellen Park: ops note: in private/on-prem installs, default to stricter thresholds. tenants can later relax via explicit opt-in.
qa-bot: scheduled: head-coverage harness run queued at 1809990016 :gear:
Ellen Park: assigning: Victor -> prompt sets, Liam -> lint and migration, me -> addendum and canary wiring. I'll post the addendum link here when done. Closing thread for now.
